import numpy as np
rng_free = np.array([[3.0, 0.5, 0.0], [0.2, 4.0, 1.0], [0.0, 0.3, 5.0]])
KqC = np.array([[0.4, 0.1], [0.0, 0.2], [0.3, 0.0]])
KCq = np.array([[0.5, 0.0, 0.1], [0.2, 0.3, 0.0]])
KCC = np.array([[3.0, 0.4], [0.1, 2.0]])
Rq = np.array([1.0, -2.0, 0.5])
RC = np.array([0.2, 0.7])
dq = condensed_correction(rng_free, KqC, KCq, KCC, Rq, RC)
dC = -np.linalg.solve(KCC, RC) - np.linalg.solve(KCC, KCq) @ dq
assert np.allclose(RC + KCq @ dq + KCC @ dC, target)

import numpy as np
Kqq = np.eye(2)
KqC = np.zeros((2, 2))
KCq = np.zeros((2, 2))
KCC = np.zeros((2, 2))
Rq = np.ones(2)
RC = np.ones(2)
def run_model():
    try:
        condensed_correction(Kqq, KqC, KCq, KCC, Rq, RC)
        return 0
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        return 1
    except Exception:
        return 2
assert np.allclose(run_model(), target)
